item.title: Building a GitOps Microservices Architecture on AWS
item.description: This project details the implementation of an end-to-end DevOps Microservices architecture on AWS, leveraging a GitOps workflow with Terraform, AWS EKS, GitHub Actions, and ArgoCD. It highlights key challenges encountered during deployment and their practical solutions.
